title: Project pages flat: the four repo-fact tiles become a ruled fact row, and the embed frame's outer card goes so the iframe's own edge is the only one
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)'. Ruling: operator-no-cards-except-floats. --gamecult-rule exists after home-flat. Line numbers from 410485e; re-read by selector.

Surfaces: .gamecult-repo-fact (956-965; nine project pages, four tiles each: Started, Last Public Push, Stack, Status, with a mono-style uppercase label at 967-974); .gamecult-embed-frame (in the shared card selector at 2084 after home-flat, plus 2393-2397; /Projects/CultPong wraps a YouTube iframe, /Blog/cat-and-the-chocolate-factory wraps the interactive fiction applet). The iframe inside (2399-2405) has its own radius 14px and ground: that is the embed's own edge, like the img inside a media card, and stays. The frame around it is a card around a card.
The repo-link pills (.gamecult-repo-link, 928-947) sit directly above the facts on the same pages; pending under self-masthead-pills-first, not touched.

Mechanism: the facts grid (949-954, auto-fit minmax(9rem, 1fr)) stays; each fact becomes a ruled column: border-top var(--gamecult-rule), padding-top, no inset. The embed frame keeps its margin and loses its box and padding.

deletes.note: 956-965 .gamecult-repo-fact: padding, border, border-radius, background (5 lines) deleted; replaced by the two lines in adds.
2084: .gamecult-embed-frame removed from the shared card selector, leaving .gamecult-media-card { ... }. 2393-2397 .gamecult-embed-frame: padding and overflow: hidden deleted; margin stays.

keeps_moves: .gamecult-embed-frame iframe (2399-2405): width, min-height, border 0, border-radius 14px, background unchanged; mobile min-height (2510-2512) unchanged.
figure.gamecult-media-card: the only rule left in the shared card selector; unchanged.

file_changes.change: repo fact: box deleted, top rule written.
embed frame: padding and overflow deleted.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the fact row's grouping through --gamecult-rule; the embed's own edge is owned by the iframe rule; the project markdown owns the facts' content.
inputs: the project pages' repo-facts and embed-frame markup
outputs: a ruled four-column fact row on nine project pages
one edge around each embed, the iframe's
derived_state: the embed's radius is the iframe's; the frame contributes no box
forbidden_writers: no background, border (other than border-top), border-radius or box-shadow on .gamecult-repo-fact or .gamecult-embed-frame
no change to .gamecult-repo-link, the masthead, the engine or content
shared_paths: the same token and the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The fact tile box and the embed frame's card and padding are deleted before the top rule is written.
